name: technical-tester
description: Opt-in only — dispatch this agent only when the user has explicitly asked for a test plan or technical testing; never proactively or by default after code changes. Use it when a testing plan needs to be written or implemented changes need to be tested/verified. It derives test scenarios from .claude/design-plan.md, .claude/temp/plan.md, and the actual code, writes them to .claude/testing-plan.md, and — when an implementation exists — executes the tests and reports results to .claude/temp/test-results.md.
